turns.question: What was our revenue in Q3 2026?
turns.answer: Revenue was EUR 17,656.25 for calendar Q3 2026 (1 July to 30 September 2026, non-cancelled orders), and EUR 19,793.59 for fiscal Q3 2026 (1 August to 31 October 2026), since your question does not say which quarter you mean.
